description: This file contains utility classes and functions for Spark Streaming in PySpark, including transformation function wrappers, serializers, and a filename generator based on RDD timestamps.

classes.name: TransformFunction
classes.description: Wraps a function for transforming RDDs in Spark Streaming, enabling calls from Java via Py4J.

classes.name: TransformFunctionSerializer
classes.description: Serializes and deserializes Python transform functions for Spark Streaming.

methods.name: rdd_wrapper
methods.description: Sets a custom RDD wrapper function.

methods.name: call
methods.description: Executes the transformation function on given RDDs at a specified timestamp.

methods.name: getLastFailure
methods.description: Returns the last exception traceback if the call failed.

methods.name: __repr__
methods.description: String representation of the TransformFunction instance.

methods.name: dumps
methods.description: Serializes a transform function to a byte array.

methods.name: loads
methods.description: Deserializes a byte array back into a TransformFunction.

methods.name: getLastFailure
methods.description: Returns the last exception traceback if serialization/deserialization failed.

methods.name: __repr__
methods.description: String representation of the TransformFunctionSerializer instance.

methods.name: rddToFileName
methods.description: Generates a filename string based on a prefix, optional suffix, and timestamp.
